articles.title: Crypto Long & Short: Crypto exchanges shouldn’t double as the vault
articles.snippet: A single breach moved billions out of Binance in minutes, exposing how much client money sits with the venue that trades it. Darren Jordan of Komainu argues institutions should keep trading and custody separate, as traditional markets have for decades, and sets out the questions to ask about where assets are held.

articles.title: Hong Kong wants banks to use AI to catch crypto crime before money disappears
articles.snippet: As Hong Kong pushes banks to use AI to combat crypto crime, experts say the technology must detect suspicious transfers without putting customer funds at risk.

articles.title: Ledger CTO Charles Guillemet to leave after nine years at company
articles.snippet: Guillemet helped establish Ledger’s Donjon security lab and says his departure has been planned for months.

articles.title: Bitcoin ETF assets fall to three-month low as 2026 net outflows top $2.5B
articles.snippet: US spot Bitcoin ETFs lost $306.4 million Wednesday, pushing their combined assets to $77.7 billion as Bitcoin briefly traded below $63,000.

articles.title: Anthropic Tops SpaceX's Initial IPO With $81 Billion Deal: Where the Money Went
articles.snippet: The Claude maker beat SpaceX's original share sale, though not its expanded final IPO. Here's who got the money and why the computing bill could be even bigger.
